question: Has either paralogue lost a catalytic or substrate-binding residue?
result: Both intact. erg13A E86/C118/H259, erg13B E86/C120/H263, 1:1 with ScERG13 E127/C159/H296 and HsHMGCS1 E95/C129/H264. All 5 further binding residues present and identical. 467 vs 460 aa, neither truncated, largest internal gap 13 aa.
source: UniProt Q4WBQ3/Q4WXT8 + Needleman-Wunsch alignment, this run

question: Do published datasets resolve and separate the two loci?
result: One dataset resolves both (PMID 22309491, hypoxia). Both decrease, erg13B more than erg13A. Magnitude only, no per-gene fold change recovered. All other mentions are single-locus survey tables.

question: Do the promoters differ in CBC, SreA or SREBP elements?
result: 1500 bp upstream, 10 genes, 3 motif classes, 2000 shuffles each. Nothing at FDR q<0.05 (all q=1.0). Head to head CCAAT 3v2 p=1.000, GATA 1v5 p=0.219, SRE 0v0.
source: NCBI promoter retrieval + permutation test, this run

question: Is one copy under stronger selection for translational efficiency?
result: erg13B CAI 0.587 (96.2 pct) vs erg13A 0.454 (86.7 pct). Diff +0.133 = 1.42 background sd, bootstrap 95% CI +0.070 to +0.195, p=0.0003. Nc 42.66 vs 47.34. Holds within chromosome; GC3 runs opposite (73.0% vs 65.7%).
strength: Moderate. Evolutionary proxy for average translation, not a measurement, and branch-blind.

question: Has either gene been deleted, repressed or called essential?
result: Nothing for either locus. No single deletion, no conditional repression, no double perturbation.
source: Europe PMC locus ID x essential/deletion/knockout/null

question: Are the two copies equally retained across Eurotiomycetes?
result: Two reciprocally monophyletic clades. erg13B clade in 7/7 sampled; erg13A clade absent from A. nidulans and T. marneffei. erg13B closer on 6/6 outgroups, sign test p=0.016.
strength: Weak to moderate. Single distance method, no bootstrap.

question: Do they sit in different classes of neighbourhood?
result: erg13A 63,094 bp from the chr 8 end (1,833,124 bp), sub-telomeric. erg13B 1,316,463 bp from the nearest chr 3 end (4,079,167 bp). Ratio 20.9x.
strength: Weak. Correlative; position predicts dispensability, not pathway.
